text: [{"text": "The `docs` function is a Nox session.", "type": "intent"}, {"text": "The `docs` function is designed to build documentation for a project.", "type": "intent"}, {"text": "The `docs` function installs the project in editable mode.", "type": "behavioural"}, {"text": "The `docs` function installs the project's documentation-specific dependencies.", "type": "behavioural"}, {"text": "The `docs` function defines a helper method named `get_sphinx_build_command`.", "type": "structural"}, {"text": "The helper method `get_sphinx_build_command` constructs the command list for building Sphinx documentation of different kinds, such as HTML and man pages.", "type": "dataflow"}, {"text": "The helper method `get_sphinx_build_command` passes `-c docs/html` so that Sphinx uses the correct configuration directory.", "type": "dataflow"}, {"text": "The `-c docs/html` option addresses an issue with ReadTheDocs where separate configuration and source directories are not supported.", "type": "intent"}, {"text": "The `docs` function runs the command built by `get_sphinx_build_command` for both \"html\" and \"man\" builds.", "type": "behavioural"}, {"text": "The `docs` function outputs the HTML build results to `docs/build/html`.", "type": "dataflow"}, {"text": "The `docs` function outputs the man build results to `docs/build/man`.", "type": "dataflow"}, {"text": "The `docs` function has no explicit error handling or early returns.", "type": "behavioural"}]
